text:
maria_infra: Heads-up — after the 1.27 cluster upgrade tonight we're seeing autoscaler not scaling GPU node pools in us-west-2 :warning:
jonathan_sre: saw that, opened a quick alert. pods pending with nodeSelector for nvidia-gpu, cluster-autoscaler logs show 'no node groups discovered'
kai_engineering: what changed with 1.27 that would cause discovery to fail? CA should talk to the cloud provider API, not k8s API versions right?
maria_infra: that's what I thought. Error line in CA: `error while fetching node groups: unknown API version "v1beta1" for NodeGroup`
liz_platform: hmm that sounds like the cloud-provider/nodegroup CRD that our autoscaler uses changed group/version during EKS upgrade. EKS 1.27 moved to managednodegroups.k8s.aws/v1?
jonathan_sre: confirmed in control-plane logs: some nodegroup objects now expose `managedNodeGroup` in different apiVersion. autoscaler binary we're running is pinned to discovery of `eksctl.io/v1alpha5` (ancient).
kai_engineering: ok followup plan: two options — (A) roll cluster back to pre-upgrade (no thanks), (B) patch autoscaler to accept both apiVersions + add a discovery fallback, (C) temporarily scale the GPU pools to minimum manually.
maria_infra: we already scaled GPU pools up manually to keep jobs running, but that's costing us ~$4k/day while we debug :grimacing:
autoscaler-bot: incident created: CA-GPU-DISCOVERY-176345 — assigned to #eng-infra oncall
jonathan_sre: I ran a quick grep in the autoscaler vendor code: it hardcodes discovery of nodegroup CRD as `nodegroup.eks.amazonaws.com/v1beta1`. PR to add `|| nodegroup.eks.amazonaws.com/v1` should be small.
liz_platform: can we hotfix the deployed CA image in prod? we have a canary cluster where we can test patched image. Also need e2e to validate GPU nodegroup discovery and scale-to-zero/scale-up behavior.
kai_engineering: I'll prepare a branch with a small discovery change and add a unit test simulating both apiVersions. PR will be 2 files, CC'ing @maria_infra for QA steps.
maria_infra: good. also let's add a feature-flag so older clusters don't break if we change discovery order — `--enable-multi-version-nodegroup` default true for now.
jonathan_sre: note: cluster-autoscaler binary is managed by helm release `infra/cluster-autoscaler` in `infra` chart repo. We can cut a hotfix image with tag `v1.22.1-patch1` and roll just CA in us-west-2 first.
liz_platform: cost/rollback constraints: don't scale GPU pools back down until CA patch is validated. Also create a billing tag on scaled nodes so spend is traceable.
kai_engineering: pushing draft PR: https://git.internal/redwood/cluster-autoscaler/pull/492 (WIP) — changes: discovery fallback + unit tests + feature flag.
maria_infra: test plan: 1) deploy patched CA to canary, 2) create a fake managed nodegroup CRD with v1 and v1beta1, 3) simulate pending GPU pod, 4) assert CA triggers cloud provider scale up and node joins, 5) scale down test and verify drain behavior.
oncall_action: jonathan_sre will keep manual scale as a guard until patch validated.
jonathan_sre: also, we found a secondary regression: when CA discovered nodegroups via new apiVersion, it failed to parse GPU capacity annotation key `node.kubernetes.io/instance-type.gpu` — the annotation moved to `alpha.gpu.accelerator/node-type` on some managed nodes. I'll add parsing for both formats in the patch.
liz_platform: excellent. make sure to add a migration note in the release notes and a console alert for customers using dedicated GPU pools so they don't accidentally hit scaling gaps.
kai_engineering: tests passing locally. kicking off a canary deploy now.
autoscaler-bot: deploy started: infra/cluster-autoscaler v1.22.1-patch1 -> canary-us-west-2
maria_infra: monitoring prometheus: alert rule `GPUPodsPending > 5m` cleared in canary after ~3m.
jonathan_sre: rolling to primary cluster in 15m if no regressions. leaving manual scale at +1 GPU pool node until primary validates.
maria_infra: follow-up items: create a small runbook for future k8s upgrades with checklist: - check autoscaler CRD discovery compatibility - smoke test GPU scale-up - billing tagging - rollout window. I'll put it in /docs/runbooks/k8s-upgrades.md after this incident.
liz_platform: also we should add CI gating for cluster versions in our autoscaler repo — matrix test against 1.24..1.27.
jonathan_sre: postmortem notes: root cause = autoscaler discovery hard-coded to obsolete nodegroup apiVersion + unhandled annotation format change for GPU instance types. Impact = temporary manual scaling and cost spike. Fix = multi-version discovery + annotation parsing + feature flag.
maria_infra: thanks everyone. keep thread updated with the rollout status. :thumbsup:
